column1: # ARC 3 / R13 -- THE ADJUDICATED CEILINGS OF THE EXTERNAL-TRUTH FLOW
# One row per (leg, isa).  A leg's HEADLINE is the count of rows where the
# tracer drops information a reference states, or where the difference is not
# understood.  The CEILING is the value a maintainer has adjudicated, row by
# row, in the verdict named in ADJUDICATION.  The gate FAILS when a headline
# EXCEEDS its ceiling, when a report is missing, when a headline cannot be
# parsed, or when the leg's scored population is below FLOOR.
# A ceiling is never a target.  RETIRED_BY names the work item whose landing
# must lower it; a ceiling with no RETIRED_BY is one this project accepts as
# a property of the reference, not of the trace.

exec35/pinrepro/EVIDENCE.md -- THE LEG IS REPRODUCIBLE NOW, SO THE CEILING IS THE MEASUREMENT.  #294 is closed AT SOURCE and the cause was not noise: qemu-user resolves the guest with realpath() and hands the result to it as AT_EXECFN (linux-user/main.c exec_path = real_exec_path; elfload.c NEW_AUX_ENT(AT_EXECFN, info->file_string)), so the guest stack -- and every pointer the delta model is built from -- moves with the LENGTH OF THE OUTPUT DIRECTORY PATH.  Measured: nine extra characters move rsp by 0x10; three runs at output-path length 60 read 278/278/278 and three at 51 read 266/266/266, which is the whole 265..278 span this row used to carry.  run_reg_arm.sh now runs both halves from a FIXED-WIDTH work directory (width asserted, symlink refused), pins CPU affinity (the native half CPUID leaf 1 EBX[31:24] read 0x03 on one run and 0x44 on the next), passes -seed 1 (qemu-user serves AT_RANDOM and getrandom from its own PRNG) and states RLIMIT_STACK.  THREE consecutive runs at output-path lengths 56 / 65 / 75 and TWO different guest-mapping placements: criterion 261 / 261 / 261, row multisets identical for two of the three pairs and differing in FOUR ORTHOGONAL rows for the third -- the two TLS canary-check sites and their two flag consumers, the one input no userspace flag can pin (the kernel draws AT_RANDOM per execve).  So the ceiling is 261 with NO MARGIN: the reproducible measurement is the authority, and a headline of 262 is a finding to open, not slack to spend.  #293 is closed in the same pass and IS the 265 -> 261: the two rules that convicted on the encoding alone are replaced by syscall_effects(), which asks each side whether IT performed the write -- r11 against its own rflags, rcx against its own next instruction address.  Both sides had; the disagreement was the flags word that arrived (PF alone, the #272 pointer-placement class), and the report now prints that adjudication per instance, unconditionally.  The tripwire still convicts: a planted arm that stops the tracer writing r11 reads QEMU-USER-SYSCALL-CLOBBER-NOT-PERFORMED:tracer-r11-is-not-its-own-rflags on 13 r11 + 2 flags rows and 261 -> 277.  The 261 decomposes: 258 UNACCOUNTED value rows (the pointer residue adjudicated at exec33), 1 TRACER-SUBSET value row, 1 TRACER-SUBSET set row (rdsspq), and 1 destination the tracer named without a value (258+1+1+1 = 261; the 2 ripsrc rows sit inside the 258); the wrong path is untouched (no tracer or QEMU source changed in this pass).
